name: gbrain
role: sidecar knowledge brain beside the world tools; not a harness under test

corpus.slice: world/seed/world.json: source_slugs of non-DM channels loaded for the split plus files with visibility public loaded for the split; page slug <split>/<corpus slug>

embeddings: off (gbrain init --no-embedding; import --no-embed); search is keyword-only and the brain makes no model or embedding call
model_calls: none; the sidecar environment carries no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY and no provider base URL

serve_env.GBRAIN_HOME: /brain (a per-trial copy of /brains/$HE_GBRAIN_SPLIT; the brain records absolute paths, so it is served where it was built)
serve_env.GBRAIN_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: 64 random hex characters minted per trial, never written anywhere

auth: gbrain auth create trial-<trial id>; the bearer token gbrain_<hex> goes to $HE_GBRAIN_OUT/token (mode 0600) and nowhere else; only the world's /gbrain tap presents it
wire: POST /mcp, Authorization: Bearer <token>, Accept: application/json, text/event-stream; replies are SSE-framed JSON-RPC (event: message / data: {...}); GET /mcp is 405; /health is unauthenticated
image: harness-eval/gbrain:dev (gbrain/Dockerfile, built from the repository root with -f gbrain/Dockerfile); /brains/dev and /brains/heldout with manifest.json each
reaches: the host loopback only, through a published port; the harness container reaches gbrain only through the world's POST /gbrain tap
